question: Why does New Westminster need a permanent masjid?
answer: New Westminster has had a thriving Muslim community for many years, but finding suitable land for a permanent masjid has been a longstanding challenge. Our current musalla has reached capacity for daily prayers and regularly overflows during Jumu'ah. A permanent masjid will provide the space and stability our growing community needs for generations to come.

question: Why was this location chosen?
answer: The site is centrally located in New Westminster, with convenient access to public transit and parking in the surrounding area. Importantly, we have also received written assurances from the City that the existing musalla's approved use can be transferred to the new site.

question: How many musallees will the new masjid accommodate?
answer: The initial masjid will be a single-storey, approximately 4,800 sq. ft. structure at 802 Eighth Street, designed to accommodate approximately 300 musallees for prayer. The prefabricated structure will be designed with future expansion in mind so that the facility can grow alongside the community.

question: Will I receive a tax receipt for my donation?
answer: Yes. Eligible donations will receive an official charitable tax receipt, which will be issued after the end of the calendar year.

question: Is CICS taking any interest-bearing loans to build this masjid?
answer: No. CICS is committed to completing this project without interest-bearing financing. Qard Hasan (interest-free loans) was used to help fund the initial property acquisition, and these funds need to be repaid by May 2027.

question: How can I help besides donating?
answer: There are many ways to support the project beyond donating. Join the volunteers chat in our WhatsApp Community to help with fundraising and site-preparation activities. You can also spread the word, encourage others to contribute, or connect us with individuals and businesses interested in donating, promoting the project, or sponsoring fundraising activities.

question: Can I give Qard Hasan?
answer: Yes. If you would like to support the project through a Qard Hasan (interest-free loan), please contact our Fundraising Committee at newmasjid@cicsnw.org or by phone/WhatsApp at +1 604-780-0048 to discuss further.

question: Can my employer match my donation?
answer: Employer donation matching is coming soon. We are working to make the project available through employer matching programs and will share more information once this option is ready.
